test_recognition: test the recognition_predictor to extract text lines from an image using detection_predictor
test_recognition_input_text: test the recognition_predictor with optional input_text parameter for performance validation
test_recognition_drop_repeats: test the recognition_predictor with drop_repeated_text flag to filter duplicate text regions
test_recognition_clean_math: test the clean_math_tags utility to remove malformed math tags and br elements from math markup
test_recognition_clean_math_preserve_tex: test the clean_math_tags utility preserves regular text with inline math and unknown tags unchanged
